A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 16-page CoLaR paper, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the scientific content matches; differences are limited to the arXiv stamp and PDF metadata.

before.justification: v5 reports original benchmark experiments and ablations in Tables 1–3, plus layer-wise, reinforcement-learning training, and scaling analyses in Appendices B–D.

after.justification: v6 retains the same original benchmark experiments, ablations, and empirical appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical embedding compression, probabilistic Latent Head, supervised losses, inference procedure, and GRPO training.

E1.justification: Both versions retain GSM8k-Aug, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MATH evaluations, together with the GSM-8k, MATH-500, and GPQA scaling experiments. No dataset or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches in Tables 1–3, including CoT, iCoT, Coconut, and Distill (the CODI reproduction) in Table 1 and TokenSkip in Table 3.

E3.justification: The splits, sample sizes, accuracy and reasoning-length metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures in Section 4 and Appendix A are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain identical component and reward-averaging ablations, latent-reasoning case study, compression-factor tests, and supplementary layer-wise, training-curve, and scaling analyses.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains five evaluation runs and 95% confidence intervals. Appendix A retains training seed 0 and evaluation seeds 0–4; uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match, including CoLaR-5's 41.7% average accuracy and 4.57 reasoning steps in Table 1. Tables 2–3 and appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, embedding variance-scaling argument, and equations (1)–(5) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about dynamic latent compression, accuracy–efficiency tradeoffs, and reinforcement-learning gains.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged, including those in Appendices B–D. Section 5 retains the same qualifications concerning CoT performance, compression-factor generalization, and societal implications.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain identical implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, normalization, and data-splitting disclosures. The project URL and its embedded hyperlink target are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 38 references and related-work discussion remain, with unchanged positioning relative to explicit reasoning, Coconut, CODI, and other latent-reasoning approaches.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v5 dated 21 Oct 2025 to v6 dated 3 Feb 2026. PDF author metadata reorders the final two names, but the visible byline, prose, headings, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All eight figures, three tables, captions, and page layouts match. Rendered pages 2–16 are identical; page 1 differs only in the arXiv stamp text.

improvement.justification: v6 preserves v5's scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation, including all appendices. The administrative stamp and metadata updates produce no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
